description: Improvements in the regional earthquake focal mechanism catalogue for southwestern Yukon is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Earthquake source characteristics provide a valuable constraint on fault behaviour, crustal stress, and regional plate tectonics. In southwestern Yukon, a region of complex active tectonics, studies of earthquake sources have historically been limited by sparse seismic network coverage. Coverage: Government of Yukon. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Its tags are ygs-import, ygs-import-20250711, ygs-publications, yukon-geological-survey, importation d'ygs. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, PDF. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
